MW.statistical_scope: Development screen on three shared seeds; catalogue/load cells are paired within each seed, not independent replicates. Seed aggregates are descriptive, with no 24-pair significance test.
MW.limitations: Fixed-rate Poisson, deterministic cached independent lanes; no drift, actual P90 bound or physical execution claim. Computation excluded from service clock. Per-class and per-seed regressions retained.
